title: New York Events
content: I enjoyed meeting a lot of fellow artists and Gurney Journey readers a week ago at theSociety of Illustratorsin New York. Thanks again to everyone at S of I!For those who missed me at that venue, I hope you can make it to the "Dinotopia: Behind the Scenes" digital slide show theNew York Comic Con, Saturday at noon in Room 1E02, with a signing at the Andrews McMeel booth 1715 at 2:00. For the full NYCC schedule,link.
